method: From hdb-blocks-geocoded-derived.csv (901 blocks in candidate HDB towns): kept residential == 'Y' and match_quality exact or ambiguous; points at OneMap SVY21 X/Y; kept points within the Queenstown planning-area polygon; subzone from point-in-polygon with MP2019 subzones. x, y are SVY21 metres. All HDB Property Information columns kept unchanged (dwelling-unit counts as integers).
purpose: Household locations and dwelling units by flat type for Queenstown.
